articleTitle: Early Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease from MRI Images Using PNN
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Here we propose a new method for the diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease from MRI images. The most prevalent, reliable and result-oriented methods for diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease are: Firstly, measuring the rate of atrophy of the hippocampus and total brain volume; Secondly, extracting information from the gray matter, white matter and cerebro spinal fluid (CSF) of the brain. In this work, different statistical features such as contrast, homogeneity, correlation, energy and also shape features are extracted from the MRI images. For every image a number of features are extracted and these are fed to the classifier. The images are classified into any of the three classes: Alzheimer's Disease (AD), Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) or Normal Control (NC). The proposed approach compares the performances of Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN), Support Vector Machines(SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) in terms of their accuracy, specificity and sensitivity. The MRI images are obtained from the ADNI database. ADNI is a clinically validated database of MRI, PET and FMRI images of subjects.

articleTitle: Portable and Centralised E-Health Record System for Patient Monitoring Using Internet of Things(IoT)
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Electronic health record system is an informal, non-statutory method of surveying, receiving and checking various health parameters for health monitoring. Routine medical checkup is the only way for human to lead a healthy life. Storing and retrieving of medical history of a patient is very essential for proper disease diagnosis. Improper identification of patient may lead to incorrect dosages of medicines, inaccurate lab work, misdiagnosis, results reported for the wrong person etc. An effective centralized health record system was not developed for this. Here, a portable, low cost, light weighted, low power electronic health record system device is proposed to record and monitor health parameters. This system facilitates continuous real time analysis of various patient parameters such as ECG, heart rate, temperature and foot pressure by using various sensors respectively. The collected data are sent to the cloud using Internet of Things (IoT). The IoT helps to connect various sensors with a common platform. GPS helps to track Patient location during an emergency. Medical history of each patient including medical reports is stored in cloud for easy access. RFID tags are also incorporated with this system for patient identification. This device is successfully tested with real time data.

articleTitle: Grid Inertia Based Frequency Regulation Strategy of Photovoltaic System Without Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The integration of solar PV sources to the grid significantly reduces the dependence on non-renewable energy sources for power requirements. This leads to the reduction in the stored kinetic energy of the system and the systems capability to overcome the power mismatch between power supply and demand gets affected. This paper presents a novel frequency control strategy of grid-connected PV system with the estimated system inertia. In the proposed method PV is forced participate in inertial response by shifting its operating point away from maximum power point only when the system inertia is not satisfactory to address initial frequency excursion. Simulation study for the frequency control is performed on the 14-bus IEEE test system in the presence of high penetration of PV sources.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Hybrid MPPT for Photovoltaic Modules
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In PV systems, the most widely used algorithm for tapping the solar energy efficiently is the maximum power point tracking method. There are two accepted methods of MPPT, which are incremental conductance method and perturb and observe method. But both these methods, when operated conventionally suffers from certain demerits, such as the complexity in operation and the resulting delay in response. This paper proposes a new technique of maximum power point tracking, incorporating the concepts of artificial neural network into conventional algorithm. This new algorithm is simple and has a faster response.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Intrusion Detection for Virtualized Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Recent times have seen a steady shift of technology from traditional software models to the cloud. The substantial growth in the number of applications using cloud based infrastructures calls for the need of security mechanisms for their protection. Intrusion detection systems are one of the most suitable security solutions for protecting cloud based environments. Although there are several approaches to intrusion detection, such as signature-based and anomaly-based, machine learning (ML) based approaches have emerged as a recent interest and research area. With their robust learning models, and data centric approach, ML based security solutions for cloud environments have been proven effective. Attack features are extracted from network and application logs. Attack presence is confirmed by performing Machine learning techniques such as logistic regression and belief propagation. Performance measures such as average detection time is used to evaluate the performance of the approach.

articleTitle: Analysis of Alzheimer Condition in T1-Weighted MR Images Using Texture Features and K-NN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: (AD) Alzheimer's disease is widely recognized as a disorder of the mental processes initiated by brain disease which a□ects more than 35 million individuals around the world. Structural Magnetic Resonance (MR) imaging strategies noninvasive tool and it assumes a significant part in analyzing Structural brain changes in subjects with neurodegenerative infections. Magnetic resonance imaging which delineates the pathology of brain structures and enhances the finding of the AD. This paper gives an analysis of Alzheimer Condition in Tl-Weighted MR Images using Texture Features and k-NN Classifier. Texture features are extracted utilizing GLCM to identify the AD and the Normal Control (NC). With a specific end goal to assess the proposed technique, performed assessments on the MRI securing from the OASIS database. The proposed strategy yields a normal testing exactness of 74.73% which demonstrates that the proposed technique can separate AD and NC agreeably.

articleTitle: Image Quality Measures Based Face Spoofing Detection Algorithm for Online Social Media
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Recent years, selfie becomes an important part of photography and considered as the powerful and trustful communication media. Nowaday's technology has been advanced much more so any one can manipulate image with available image editing software. So it became difficult to identify whether the image is spoofed or not. Many spoof detection algorithm are being developed to find fake face in biometrics system. But face spoofing recognition still persists as a challenge in online social media. In this paper, a fast and robust algorithm is proposed to detect fake faces from photographs which have shared through the online social networks. This algorithm extracts face segments in different color spaces and estimates the illuminate map of the region. In addition, this algorithm measures the image quality parameters of segment and compares with the back ground region. Reference based and Non reference based image quality parameters are used to generate feature vectors. Quadratic Discriminant Analyzer (QDA) classifier is used to recognize the fake face. The proposed algorithm is successfully tested with DSO-1, DSI-1 dataset and the result shows 96.5% accuracy in detecting fake faces.

articleTitle: Safety Alert Systems Using Dedicated Short Range Communication for on Road Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Dedicated Short Range Communications (DSRC), a wireless standard, is considered to be the most promising protocol to be used for Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V) and Vehicle to Infrastructure (V2I) communications. The DSRC standard is specifically designed for automotive use, focused on vehicular safety applications. Most of the road accidents are accounted due to non-focused drivers and unpredicted roads, which could be reduced to a great extend using DSRC enabled alert systems. This paper describes the design and implementation of DSRC based On-Board and Road Side Units as well as the architecture and functional aspects of the DSRC protocol along with two vehicular safety applications developed and tested.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Security Framework for IoT Implementations
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The buss words blockchain and internet of things has been floating around the tech world for quite a while. IoT has already proved that it can have a significant impact on our daily life. A significant amount of data is collected and transmitted through the internet from various devices across the globe. IoT consists of heterogeneous devices communicating over a wide range of networks transmitting lots of critical and non-critical data, which raises concern about the security of such collected data from the users and the ownership of the data. This paper introduces a security framework for the internet of things implementation in a confined environment, such as smart city, power grid or metro rail systems, etc. The framework ensures the secure communication and authentication of the data across such diversified networks and devices. The framework is built upon the underlying mechanism of blockchain technology combined with the use of secure hashing algorithm.

articleTitle: Blockwise Fragile Watermarking Schemes for Tamper Localization in Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper presents two fragile watermarking schemes for tamper localization in digital images. In the first scheme, the unprotected image is divided into 8×8 blocks. A 128 bit hash value is computed for each block by using MD5 algorithm. They are embedded into the two LSBs of the pixel value. The same pattern is used in the second scheme with slight modifications; the block size is 16×16, SHA-256 algorithm is used to generate a 256 bit hash value and they are inserted into the LSB of the pixel value. Experimental results show that the schemes can resist collage, vector quantization, content only and constant average attacks. The schemes provide better tamper detection rate.

articleTitle: Inter Turn Fault Diagnosis in Wound Rotor Induction Machine Using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The aim of this project is to present a new method for the early detection of faults in a three-phase wound rotor induction machines. Investigations on different failure modes in variable speed induction machines have revealed that 30-45% is stator related faults. Detection of inter-turn fault has more significance. A MATLAB/SIMULINK model is developed for the three phase induction motor with stator interturn fault and without fault and characteristics are obtained. Some of the characteristics of the motor, which changes when a fault is developed, are to be identified, which can serve as the features for the fault detection. The proposed diagnosis approach is based on the use of wavelet analysis by processing the electrical characteristics under time varying conditions. Hence it should have many advantages over other techniques due to the effectiveness of wavelet transform (WT). The wavelet transform is applied to decompose the original stator current signals into frequency bands.

articleTitle: Phasor Measurement Based Fault Detection and Blocking/De-Blocking of Distance Relay Under Power Swing
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The implementation of power swing protection philosophy, encompassing the right blocking/de-blocking techniques is a real challenge keeping in view the complexity of Indian power system. An appropriate power system protection design to preclude cascading catastrophes is the prime requirement of modern day smart power system. The present day advancement in communications and digital technologies in particular, the Wide Area Measurement Systems (WAMS) using Phasor Measurement Units (PMU) not only addresses immediate reliability issues but also paves way for efficient decision support tools - as in case of events like power swings which might prove chaos for power system during untoward situations. A recent blackout incident in Indian power system has motivated the authors to ponder upon schemes which offer an efficient, practical solution for this well known issue, but an issue which still disturbs the power system network with blackouts - distance relay misoperation during power swing. In this paper, a Differential Power Coefficient (DPC) is derived utilising real time voltage and current phasors acquired by Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) and the angular separation between the buses connecting faulted line. The angular separation is also collected from PMU measurement. The DPC encompasses the effect of differential power during fault conditions in transmission system as well as variation in angular separation of connecting buses during swing. The DPC is used in detecting events of symmetrical faults during power swing with least time delay and accordingly proposes a logic scheme for blocking/de-blocking of distance relays.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach for Detecting Ransomware Using Static and Dynamic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Ransomware has been a rising threat in the past few years. By analyzing the number of systems that are infected by ransom ware and the amount of ransom paid by the user, the damage done to an IT infrastructure is measured. There are many deployment methods in which the ransomware get into the system. These are similar to malware and ransomware is a form of malware whose central behavior is to prevent legitimate users from accessing the resources when needed. This paper discusses the static and dynamic techniques that can be used to detect and prevent a ransomware attack.

articleTitle: A Framework for Intelligent Learning Assistant Platform Based on Cognitive Computing for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder(ASD) suffer from social and communication issues. In addition to that they also exhibit a complex collection of behaviors which makes it difficult for the trainers to identify the methodology to be adapted for training them. At present a mishmash of techniques are used to evaluate them in general, without identifying their uniqueness or specific characteristics. In this paper, we propose a cognitive computing based intelligent learning assistant that could provide suitable courseware by identifying a child specifically based on the behavioural patterns that aids the autistic student's learning. A hybrid approach which blends cognitive, developmental and behavioural psychology is used to generate an autism assessment model, by using which a specific courseware is provided to the child. An interactive chatbot along with a visual aid is used as an interface to interact with the child so as to capture his real-time responses. This system features Reinforcement learning, Regional Convolution Neural Network (R-CNN), Deep Convolution Neural Network (deep-CNN) to provide a personalized learning assistant platform for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder(ASD).

articleTitle: Motion Planning and Control of an Autonomous Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper introduces an efficient motion planning method for autonomous mobile robots, which is based on the rapidly exploring random tree (RRT) algorithm. RRT belongs to the class of sampling-based algorithm and is widely used to solve the motion path planning problem of mobile robots. In this context, a motion planning method for a differential driven mobile robot is discussed which includes an improved RRT variant with a closed loop postprocess for the generation of control sequence for the robot. The motion planning subsystem is integrated with the associated controller. The RRT based motion planning subsystem runs an onward simulation using a system model and the controller to determine the state trajectory. It uses the controller in two different ways: 1) To Eliminate the error in the position between reference and actual path 2) To eliminate the error in the orientation. It utilises a PI controller and a pure pursuit controller. Thus, the controller not only facilitates the execution of the motion plan but also ensures reduction in error in the predicted trajectory ensuring acceptable performance.

articleTitle: Bio-Inspired Algorithms for Software Defined Network Controllers
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN) paradigm enables the control of the entire network and the packet flow in a dynamic manner based on the network status and network application requirements through software. This includes routing of packets with flow table settings in Data plane, traffic engineering with support for Quality of Service, multipath routing etc. Many of these functions have Graph theory based algorithms and implementations in SDN Controller. SDN Controller faces many challenges in achieving network security, reliability, and scalability. Bio-inspired algorithms provide metaheuristic approaches which lead to robust, low complexity solutions to many of the problems. In this paper, we review the various bio-inspired algorithms and their suitability for implementation in SDN Controllers for bringing in better performance and discuss the future work required in this direction.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Fall Detection System for Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Parkinson's Disease (PD) is a progressive, Neurodegenerative disease caused by the degeneration of dopamine neurons in the brain. The PD patients often fall and cause further damages to their physical conditions because of the abnormal gaits such as shuffling and festinating steps or freezing of gait. The objective behind creating a fall detection system is to provide an ambulatory gait analysis system for preventing the fall and thereby help PD patients, from further regression and physical injury due to fall. This system can also facilitate long term monitoring of motor abnormalities in PD patients during daily activities. Once the system detects abnormal gaits, auditory cues will be given to the PD patients and caregivers by their side and thus help patients prevent falls in their daily living. This paper specifies a Single Gyroscope with Standard Deviation Algorithm using data from single gyroscope attached to the shank of the body used for the detection and prevention of fall in PD patients. The sensor MPU6050 used in the system is a motion sensor having gyroscope and accelerometer with the advantages of being highly portable, low cost and wireless nature.

Author Keywords: Single Gyroscope with Standard Deviation Algorithm

articleTitle: Automatic Spotting of Vowels, Nasals and Approximants from Speech Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Automatic speech recognition involves methodologies for translation of spoken language into text. An important problem that needs to be solved for the success of speech recognition is the accurate detection of phonemes. In this paper, a two stage system for spotting the boundaries of vowels, nasals and approximants in Malayalam speech signal is proposed. In the first stage, speech signal is classified into six broad phoneme classes using an Artificial Neural Network based broad phoneme classifier. Classifier with nine features has limited accuracy for detecting vowel, nasal and approximant boundaries. So features like difference of spectral spread, spectral centroid, envelope variance, energy ratio, difference in formant frequencies are added to the classifier. With these additional features, a major improvement in classifier accuracy is achieved. In the second stage, a frequency domain parameter named spectral peak frequency is suggested for accurate verification of nasals. Sonorant and nonsyllabic features are used for verifying approximants and syllabic feature is used for locating vowels.

articleTitle: Load Sharing Control and Circulating Current Minimization of Parallel DC-DC Converters Based on Droop Index
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: DC microgrid is getting more concern in the modern microgrid, due to its capability to integrate Distributed energy resources (DERs) and less complex city and control issues. Nevertheless load sharing is a major issue in DC microgrid. Droop control is considered as the most popular method for load sharing control in DC microgrid, while there may be tradeoff between load current and voltage regulation. The Proposed method is based on virtual Rdroop, where optimum value of Rdroop is selected based on droop index calculation. This Droop index calculation effectively reduces the load current deviation and voltage regulation issues also resolves circulating current issues and reduces power losses in converters. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified and analyzed using Matlab simulation.

articleTitle: Demand Side Management for a Household Using Resource Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The paper proposes a resource scheduling algorithm in a residential scenario. Owing to the new trends of consumers using renewable energy sources we need to utilize the energy harvested efficiently and economically. The proposed algorithm minimizes the cost of total energy consumed by an individual household. Here mainly the energy storage devices like battery are considered to support in improving the savings with efficient energy consumption pattern. The concept of battery scheduling put forward in this paper brings forth a flexible demand side management technique. In the conventional load management programs additional complex computations were involved while this simple resource scheduling algorithm gives good results and is easier to implement. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated through MATLAB simulations.

articleTitle: Indoor Light Harvesting Using Dye Sensitized Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Solar power has assumed a vital and established role in the present day's clean energy economy. Ever since silicon solar cells developed, the prime focus has always been to harness the outdoor sunlight. The indoor light, though of lesser intensity than its outdoor counterpart, has the potential to power on devices such as wireless sensor nodes (WSN) that work in the low power range. Harnessing electrical power from indoor lighting environment with very low luminance level is relatively anew and challenging concept. The limitation of the existing silicon solar cells to perform efficiently under the indoor lighting condition restricts its deployment. The Dye Sensitized Solar Cell (DSSC), also known as the next generation solar cell, with its better conversion efficiency can work effectively in low lighting conditions such as cloudy skies and indirect sunlight. In addition, it has the capability to absorb light from various light sources that are usually used to illuminate indoor rooms. The WSN systems are conventionally battery powered. The power storage capabilities of DSSCs could eliminate the additional need for a battery and thus reduces the number of batteries deposited into environment. The paper intends to carry out an experimental study on DSSC and its potential application as an energy harvester.

articleTitle: Computerized Detection of Macular Edema Using OCT Images Based on Fractal Texture Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Macular edema (ME) is a significant cause that results in blindness among majority. It happens due to the anomalous leakage and builds up of fluids within macular region. Anything that relates with the performance of eyes can drive the chances to become a ME patient. ME can occur as a downstream of eye related surgeries, degradation due to aging or any eye disorders causing inflammation. The main fact about ME that if the disease is not identified and diagnosed at the earlier stages, the chance of recovery is minimal and can ultimately affect the ability to see. One of the main causes of ME is the disease which can injure blood vessels in the retina. Laser photocoagulation and vitrectomy are the common method available now for diagnosing the disease. Optical Coherence Tomography alias OCT, an advanced imaging technique to capture retinal layer region. Different algorithms were implemented to detect ME from OCT images, but early detection of ME is not possible. This paper utilizes segmentation based fractal texture analysis (SFTA) to derive the feature vector. Graph based segmentation employs in the detection of layers and QDA classifies the ME images. This algorithm will help the ophthalmologist to treat the patient at early stages. The algorithm is deployed successfully on a macular edema dataset, with 97.5% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Routing with Minimum Delay for Mesh Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In a network, nodes communicate with each other by transferring packets. If there are two nodes which are not neighbors need to transfer packets among them, then they will achieve it by forwarding packets through their neighboring nodes. A complex design of nodes connected together form a mesh network. In mesh architecture, the network performance for transferring packets depends on the efficiency of algorithms which are used for routing. In most of the mesh networks, when the complexity of architecture increases, there are more chances for network failure. One of the main challenges of fault- tolerant minimal routing algorithms are checking the existence of fault-tolerant minimal paths. It should also tolerate arbitrary fault distribution. The algorithm should not sacrifice those paths which are minimal and fault tolerant. It should work on low time complexity. The proposed algorithm will find fault tolerant path from source to destination with minimum manhattan distance. The packet transmission delay of every available shortest manhattan path is considered so that it can find the path with minimum delay.

articleTitle: Discrete Sliding Mode Control Technique Applied to Reusable Launch Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Researchers are amassed in building up a cutting edge technology for launch vehicle. Systems like Reusable Launch Vehicles (RLVs) are subjected to changes in mission specification and disturbances, and demands the development of robust control systems. Current scenario considers the Discrete Time Sliding Mode Control (DSMC), which is still an open area of research. It is one of the robust and effective techniques for analyzing the dynamics of uncertain systems. The longitudinal dynamics of the re-entry vehicle is considered as the plant. A DSMC controller was designed based on Gao's reaching law. Pole placement technique was used in the design of sliding surface. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed controller can effectively tackle matched uncertainities and disturbances.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Networks Based Monitoring of Railway Tracks
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Growing demand for railway services necessitates a strong need to develop overall infrastructure, factoring its communication and safety mechanisms. It is vital to have a system to supervise the robustness of tracks and report as needed. Sensor enabled wireless communication promises to provide optimal solutions to reduce rail accidents. Ultrasound enabled wireless sensor network (WSN) technology to provide early warning and prevention of accidents has generated interest in the research community. Two novel prototypes using WSN are designed and tested. The uniqueness of the approach lies in the contact (guide based) and contact-less sensing mechanism. The results obtained are encouraging and show tremendous scope for gainful exploitation in the future.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Multi-Level Diode Clamped Inverter Fed Surface Mounted PMSM Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper gives the performance comparison of DCMLI fed to SPMSM drive with different modulation techniques. SPWM, SVPWM and CBSVPWM techniques are applied. Each method has its own advantages and disadvantages. However, CBSVPWM is an easy and digital implementation method which reduces the complexity. Control methods used are FOC and DTC. SPMSM drive due to its excellent characteristics used in Electric Vehicles and Electric Traction.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Method for the Detection of Structural Abnormalities in Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia from the G-Banded Karyotypes
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The automated detection of structural abnormalities in the Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL) from the karyotypes is a major technical challenge in the cytogenetic imaging developments. Structural chromosomal abnormalities are the key evidences of genetic disorders such as ALL, but the automated identification of these abnormalities is still difficult. There is no successful automated method for the classification of structural abnormalities in karyotypes and the detection of ALL from the G-banded chromosomes. Currently, the identification of the ALL specific structural abnormalities including translocations from the G-banded karyotypes are done by the cytogenetic experts in the lab manually which is labor intensive and time consuming. Mimicking the actions performed by the cytogenetic expert for abnormality detection is a challenging task. The normal and abnormal chromosomes are classified using ANN (Artificial Neural Network) which is trained using the back propagation network. The proposed template matching method which combines the correlation based similarity measures SSD (Sum of Squared Differences) block matching and NCC(Normalized Cross-Correlation) suggests an efficient automated method for the detection of ALL specific structural abnormalities from the G-banded karyotype which helps in the prognosis and treatment evaluation.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Microcontroller Based Power Electronic Converter for Nuclear Research Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Extensive variations occur in a fuel of nuclear reactor due to normal and abnormal power and temperature transients. The study of profile of these transients are of great practical importance. In order to carry out various types of nuclear reactor safety related analytical studies, such transients need to be simulated in experimental facilities. To ascertain the nuclear reactor operations in healthy as well as in abnormal situations, fast response power electronic converters are utilized in experimental facilities to manage the power and temperature profiles in a systematic fashion. The results obtained during experimentation can be used to design the thermal hydraulic systems and generation of computer codes for further safety analysis. The paper highlights the microcontroller based power electronic converter deliberated for feeding output DC power to the fuel simulator under test matrix like variation in fraction of decay power, maximum center-line and clad surface temperature of nuclear reactor. A programmable step-less reference generator also has been designed and developed for simulating various power and temperature transients interfaced with reference circuit block of the converter to obtain the desired profile feeding the simulated fuel. Simulation tool has been utilized for the design of power electronic converter including control hardware. The design schematic of microcontroller circuit in Proteus design suite and 8051 microcontroller programming in KEIL platform is also presented.

Author Keywords: Loss of coolant accident Programmable reference generator

articleTitle: ARM-FPGA Implementation of a Partially Reconfigurable OFDM-MIMO Phy-Link
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: MIMO-OFDM systems are known for high data rate and lower bit error rate (BER) in wireless communication system. These systems helps to yield high data rate and spectral efficiency over multipath and fading channels. OFDM systems use varying modulation schemes and IFFT points based on data rate requirements and number of carriers. Similarly the MIMO system uses an MxM antenna array with M ranging from 2 to M. Based on the channel conditions and environment a particular combination can perform better with maximum throughput and minimum BER. This paper explores a software defined reconfigurable hardware for the realization of MIMO-OFDM systems and a physical layer link implemented in Xilinx FPGA with partial reconfiguration. The phy link involves a QPSK and a QAM modem with 2x2 and 4x4 antenna array. Using Partial reconfiguration technique the user can switch between these two schemes in minimum time without configuring the entire FPGA which will take 2 to 3 minutes based on the application. The same hardware can be used for designing multiple combination of modulation, number of carries and antenna array with partial reconfiguration which helps to maintain same hardware and switching between the schemes.

articleTitle: Non Verbal Behaviour Analysis for Distress Detection Using Texture Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Facial expressions and gestures, which forms a part of inter personal communication, can reflect a person's true psychological state and his intent towards the whole communication scenario. During the long journey of technology development, lot of methods have been introduced for detecting the mental state of a person from such nonverbal communication aspects exhibited by the subject. The analysis of such non verbal behaviours can be used for many applications in psychiatry, in clinical, educational and organizational psychology some of which includes social skills training, military psychiatric evaluation, understanding interactions between a patient and therapist, children and parents, couples, civil servants and public etc. In this paper a novel method is presented to determine the distress level of a person by interpreting his facial expressions from salient patches using Segmentation based Fractal Texture Analysis (SFTA). To acquire texture patterns, fractal dimensions of the regions are found. Naïve Bayes classifier is used to classify the detected emotion into a predefined class. Viola Jones algorithm is used for the purpose of detection of face. The changes in the selected facial patches due to a change in emotion are extracted and analyzed for the detection of the affective state of the person. Successful testing of the proposed system is done with Extended Cohn-Kanade (CK+), Japanese female facial expression (JAFFE) database and Affectiva-MIT Facial Expression Dataset (AMFED).

articleTitle: A Review of Chaotic Analysis of EEG in Neurological Diseases
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In this review, the chaotic nature of brain signals and the relevance of their analysis are reviewed. The basic concept of chaos, historical evolution of chaos theory and various steps in chaotic analysis are outlined. The major chaotic parameters, namely largest Lyapunov Exponent and Correlation Dimension are illustrated and their computation is discussed. Finally, the results of major studies applying these techniques to various neurological diseases are also discussed.

articleTitle: Power Efficient Speaker Verification Using Linear Predictive Coding on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Speaker verification is of great importance, especially in the field of forensics and security. This paper aims at implementing such a system at the hardware level. This system extracts features from the fresh voice samples and verifies the speaker by comparing those with the ones being stored in the database. The features used here are the Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) Coefficients which are obtained using the Levinson - Durbin (LD) algorithm. This paper proposes to implement Vector Quantization (VQ) to obtain the representative LPC vectors. A simple speaker verification system for a single person is efficiently implemented on FPGA.

articleTitle: Adaptive Network Coding Based Cooperative Medium Access for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Ever since the introduction of network coding (NC) technique, several Medium Access Control (MAC) protocols based on NC have been developed for wireless networks of three node topology as well as `X' topology, considering that the information flows originate from the source (or reaches the relay) simultaneously. However, there are cases when these information flows do not occur simultaneously. In this context, a new medium access mechanism which is a modified version of CSMA/CA based IEEE 802.11 protocol is proposed in this paper, considering `X' topology based wireless network. It consists of two independent sources, transmitting to the same pair of destinations with the help of a relay node. The relay node of an ongoing cooperative transmission checks for NC opportunity before forwarding the packet to the destinations. If NC opportunity exists, then the relay initiates packet exchange with the other potential source. If not, it continues with the procedures of existing protocol. A suboptimal method of relay selection is also discussed. The proposed method is analyzed in terms of throughput and packet delay and the performance is compared with that of IEEE 802.11 based cooperative MAC protocol. Results show that the proposed protocol shows an improved performance.

articleTitle: Cascaded LQR Control for Missile Roll Autopilot
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Optimal control as a modern control system design approach when used in aerospace applications can meet the requirements of fast response with minimum settling time and good stability characteristics. Linear Quadratic Regulator is a ubiquitous controller which can be used effectively in the design of a missile roll autopilot. Roll autopilot in an aerodynamically controlled missile aims to keep roll angle and rate zero so that the roll and lateral dynamics of the missile are decoupled resulting in stable performance characteristics. This paper discusses a cascaded LQR controller for effective roll stabilization of the missile autopilot in a realistic model where the second order actuator and gyro dynamics are also considered. Simulations are carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the controller.

articleTitle: Burning Zone Temperature Estimation of Rotary Kiln Using Flame Image Analysis in Cement Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In a cement plant, the most important and critical part is the rotary kiln which is a large cylinder with a length of about 60-65 meters and a diameter of around 4.5 meters. The kiln is rotated by a powerful electrical motor. The output of kiln is clinker which is in the form of mould like balls. If the output clinker is powdered or in liquid state, then it cannot be used in further processing and will be wasted. In the current scenario, the kiln output is visually observed and the Clinker quality is hourly measured in the Laboratory. In the kiln, raw materials undergo burning around a temperature range of 1200°C to 1400°C. The clinker has to be critically burnt to achieve a desired quality. Excess heating of the raw materials leads to the production of over burnt clinker which is not useful for cement production. Such a situation results in the inefficient operation of kiln by wasting the energy spent for heating the raw materials. This is to be avoided in the cement sintering process. Burning zone temperature directly determines the characteristics of the clinker. Presently, in most of the cement plants, burning zone temperature measurement is obtained using radiation pyrometers. This measurement indicates temperature information about a particular point in the burning zone which is inadequate for the optimized operation and control of the kiln. The work includes the design and development of Image processing-based Temperature estimation System for the burning zone of a Rotary kiln.

articleTitle: Low Cost Satellite Constellation Design Using Walker's Method for a Specified Launch Station
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Satellite constellation is IRNSS, consists of 7 satellites which provides regional coverage only. The objective of this work is to design a satellite constellation for worldwide coverage, from a specified launch station and schedule the launch date and time of the satellites. Satellite constellations were developed using the Walker's method, by varying the height, inclination, orbital plane, phasing parameter using the System Tool Kit (STK) software and select the suitable one based on the parameter Geometric Dilution of Precision (GDOP). The value of GDOP should be minimum for better constellation. Satellite constellation design at a height of 23000 km, gives an arrangement of 30 satellites in 10 orbital plane, with phasing parameter 6 and inclination of 45 degree. In Walker's method, satellites are arranged uniformly at an equal altitude and inclination. Compared to polar constellation method coverage using Walker constellation method is more in the equatorial plane, also the number of satellites required per plane is low. The proposed satellite constellation gives GDOP value 2.8, hence satellite constellation is better.

articleTitle: A.I for Games with High Branching Factor
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) is a heuristic search method that is used to efficiently search decision trees. The method is particularly efficient in searching trees with a high branching factor. MCTS has a number of advantages over traditional tree search algorithms like simplicity, adaptability etc. This paper is a study of existing literature on different types of MCTS, specifically on using Genetic Algorithms with MCTS. It studies the advantages and disadvantages of this approach, and applies an enhanced variant to Gomoku, a board game with a high branching factor.

articleTitle: Study of Control Strategies for a Non-Linear Benchmark Boiler
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Boiler control is a very important task in industrial power generation. The safety and economic factors can be well maintained by proper control strategy. Control of a boiler mainly involves retaining boiler parameters such as steam pressure, water level and oxygen level at desired levels with reduced disturbance effects. Interactions within the system is a significant factor for effective boiler control. The control strategy presented in the paper deals with the analysis and reduction of multivariate interactions by keeping the boiler parameters at desired levels. The efficiency of classical control applications in boiler control is one of the main objectives of this study. The effect of Relative Gain Array analysis in interaction scrutiny, reduction of interactions using decoupling approach and effect of multiloop PID's(Proportional Integral and Derivative) is well observed in the study. The efficiency and optimality of the mentioned approaches are well observed and need for an efficient control strategy is illustrated.

articleTitle: Dual Band Circular Polarized Wearable Antenna for Military Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual band rectangular planar wearable patch antenna deployed with a L shaped dual slits covering military wireless applications. The traditional embroidery process develops aesthetic shapes using metallic threads on a base textile antenna. The overall size of the antenna is 74×40mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> which is very small compared to the wavelength at the resonant frequency. Initially the antenna performance in terms of gain, impedance matching (S11), directivity and antenna efficiency is carried with CST software simulator. However, the feeding point where the RF connector meets in obtaining perfect impedance match stands to be critical as part of antenna design. Position and orientation of the antenna shows impact on the selection of sensitive point in wearable antenna. Significance of the proposed structure with Jeans cloth (1.7 dielectric) is compared with the FR4 (4.4) conventional patch structure. The major contribution of antenna is to resonate the frequencies to operate at 3.17GHz with circular polarization and 5.04 GHz linearly polarized which has prior importance in military applications. Proposed structure also provides better enhancement in terms of 10-dB impedance bandwidth, achieved average gain of <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">~</sub>5 dBi.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Detection of Demarcation Line/Ridges in the Retinal Fundus Images of Preterm Infants
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Retinopathy of Prematurity (ROP) is a curable sight threatening disease which affects the visual system of premature infants, weighing less than 1750 grams and who are born before 31 weeks of gestation. The characteristic features of the disease include abnormal blood vessel growth and scar tissue formation in the retina which may lead to permanent blindness. The risk of ROP can be reduced if the disease is diagnosed in the early stage of its development. As per the recommendations of the International Committee for ROP classification, the detection of demarcation line/ridge have great prognostic significance as its presence indicates the beginning stage of the disease. In the reported work we develop a computer aided diagnostic system for the early detection of ROP, where the presence of ridge/demarcation line is identified in the fundus images of the preterm infants. The developed system uses image enhancement techniques followed by clustering operation. An image database with 33 retinal images of preterm infants are graded with the proposed system and the results obtained matches with that of the clinical expert annotation with a good accuracy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach to Recover CCTV Video from Proprietary DVR File System
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: CCTV cameras are extensively used for surveillance in areas that may need monitoring. CCTV footages serves an important key for investigation, as evidence in court. Nowadays, the CCTV manufacturers uses proprietary file system instead of the industry standard file system such as FAT16, FAT32, NTFS, HFS, Ext2 etc. The forensic analysis of proprietary DVR is a challenging task, as it uses a proprietary file system and not a standard one. The aim of this project is to analyze the File System of a proprietary DVR Hard Disk Drive of HIKVISION CCTV camera, a popular brand in market. This method involves reverse engineering the File System by reading and extracting CCTV videos and its metadata from the proprietary DVR Hard Disk Drive for the digital forensic investigation.

articleTitle: Interference Cancellation Using Autocorrelation Division Multiple Access Filter in MIMO Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of ADMA (Autocorrelation Division Multiple Access) filter is applied for interference cancellation in a Multiple Input Multiple output (MIMO) ad-hoc networks with limited feedback and quantized beamforming. The distance between the nodes are considered as uniformly distributed in ad-hoc network. The receiver selects the suitable beamforming coefficient from the codebook vector using Grassmannian beamforming. This is called as quantized beamforming. The receiver drives the index of the excellent beamforming coefficient by means of finite rate feedback to the transmitter. With quantized beamforming, a technique is proposed namely ADMA filter, with which the interferences are blocked and hence the capacity is also increased. The outage probability lower bound expression in MIMO ad-hoc network using quantized beamforming and is combined with limited feedback is derived using ADMA filter. Numerical simulations are specified to explain the success of the ADMA filter method and the performance is analyzed.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Adaptive Single Sensor Based MPPT for PV Applications with Conventional Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) Systems are becoming vital for the existence of mankind nowadays. From bulk power generation to space exploration applications, PV systems finds an important role. To extract power from PV device it has to be operated at its Maximum Power Point(MPP) for which different MPPT algorithms are used. On a relative study of these different MPPT algorithms it is found that most of them suffers from certain problems such as highly oscillatory response and slow tracking time. Most of these algorithms uses both current and voltage sensors, this adds to the issue of reliability of such MPPTs. Here in this study, a Single voltage sensor based Adaptive MPPT is compared with different MPPT algorithms using MATLAB/SIMULINK simulations.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Parallel Concatenated Gallager Codes with Different Types of Interleavers
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Parallel concatenated Gallager code (PCGC) is a class of concatenated code in which Low density parity check (LDPC) codes are used as component codes in interleaver-free Turbo code architecture. These codes were introduced in order to reduce the encoding and decoding complexity of long block length LDPC codes. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of PCGC along with an interleaver included, as in Turbo code architecture. Basically, we compare the performance of PCGC with random interleaver and some structured interleavers in binary symmetric channel (BSC). It is shown that PCGC with random interleaver outperforms a dedicated LDPC of same frame length and code rate over BSC. Simulation results show that structured interleavers almost achieved the performance of random interleaver for short frame length codes. Furthermore, the application of PCGC with interleaver for cognitive radio data transmission is also discussed.

articleTitle: Design of A Novel IEC 61850 Based Merging Unit for Substation Automation
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Substation Automation System (SAS) is a key component of the power distribution system of a so called “Smart City”. IEC 61850 is the modern and most popular international standard for substation automation because of its high degree of interoperability among systems from different vendors. Merging Unit (MU) is an essential building block of an IEC 61850 based SAS. A conventional MU, acquires current and voltage signals from various current and voltage transformers in the switchyard, converts them into digital form and sends the digital equivalents as sampled values through the process bus. A novel concept is envisaged in this MU design which has the additional function that it serves as a control unit with the capabilities of realtime decision making as well. This paper discusses the details involved in the design of a MU based on IEC 61850, as part of the ongoing design and development activity to bring out an indigenous solution for smart cities, executed by Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) and funded by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). The paper outlines the features implemented in the hardware & firmware and also discusses preliminary results of the lab testing carried out at C-DAC, Thiruvananthapuram, to validate the same.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement of VSI Fed Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Now a days industries demands drives operating at variable speed. In variable speed ac drives, due to the intermittent switching of power electronic switches, large amount of current is drawn from the line which results in energy deficiency, large rating of machine and increase system operating cost. So it is necessary to reduce the losses and vibration in machines. This paper mainly focuses on power quality analysis of inverter fed induction motor drive and proposes a method to improve power quality using DC-DC convertor. Power quality analysis is done by analysing Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) under different load conditions. Results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for the Extrapolation of Wind Speed Time Series to Higher Altitude Using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Mapping the wind speed profile at higher altitudes over long periods is an essential requirement in the wind energy sector and the erection and maintenance of tall wind measuring masts for this purpose pose many practical difficulties from the engineering perspective. A rather simplified method in use for this purpose is to estimate the wind profile at relatively lower heights and estimate the same to the required heights using mathematical equations formulated using a combination of theoretical and empirical research, which are often subject to uncertainties caused by the complex nature of turbulent flows and the terrain. A new approach of employing a machine learning model built on Support Vector Machine algorithm is attempted in this work to extrapolate the wind speed profile at a higher altitude from the measured values at lower heights. The measured values at 50 m and 20 m above the ground level have been separately used to train the model to predict the values at 80 m height and the comparison of the model prediction with the measured values at higher altitude shows remarkable agreement.

articleTitle: PWM Direct Torque Control of Induction Motor Drive with Reduced Torque Ripple
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper describes about a sinusoidal pulse width modulation Direct Torque Control (DTC) method for the Induction Motor drive. This method provides a constant switching frequency for the Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) and thereby eliminating the disadvantages of variable switching frequency. The modified sinusoidal PWM DTC method is compared with the conventional variable switching frequency DTC method. The modified method is also capable of reducing the torque ripple without introducing complexity to the drive system. Simulation of both the DTC methods are carried out in Matlab-Simulink platform and the results are verified for different conditions.

articleTitle: Feature Optimization and Classification of Tumor Grades Using MR Images
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: MR imaging is a well established imaging technique to identify and diagnose brain tumor at a very early stage. The tumor types are classified as glioma, meningioma, metastatis, sarcoma etc. Tumor grades can be classified into four grades depending on the level of severity. In this paper, we present identification of brain tumor type as glioma and meningioma grade using Weighted Neighbor Distance using Compound Hierarchy of Algorithms Representing Morphology (Wndchrm) and support vector machines (SVM) classifiers. Initially, features are extracted using Wndchrm tool and the most informative features are selected based on Fischer score. The SVM classifier is optimized using an iterative method in order to obtain the best constraint and kernel parameters. The optimized features obtained from Wndchrm tool is used to train SVM. The wndchrm tool gave an accuracy of 93.33% whereas SVM using Wndchrm features gave an accuracy of 80 %. Analysis of the classifier is done using performance measures namely, accuracy, specificity and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Receding Horizon Control of Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse with Rooftop Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Cooling efficiency of self-sustained naturally ventilated greenhouse extensively depends on the outside temperature and wind speed which occasionally results in overshoot while maintaining the desired temperature. To enhances the cooling capabilities numerically simulated rooftop wind turbine is integrated with the greenhouse temperature model. Its effectiveness depends on the outside wind speed. Receding Horizon Control (RHC) was implemented as the temperature control strategy for drawing comparison amongst the greenhouse temperature model and integrated rooftop wind turbine greenhouse temperature model for the same external environment. Results obtained using integrated rooftop wind turbine greenhouse model had the reduced height of overshoot in temperature as the clear indication of higher cooling capacity over the greenhouse model and also demonstrated considerable reduction in energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Photovoltaic System with Output Voltage Sensor Based MPPT with Combination of SEPIC-Cuk Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Solar energy is the most important and freely available energy source which generates DC power. While comparing the SEPIC and Cuk configuration it is observed that they have the same voltage conversion ratio with opposite polarity. Bipolar DC link has two conductors with opposite polarity. The main advantage of the this configuration is that it builds a bipolar DC link using one controllable switch. The system can be connected to the DC micro grids. Unlike the conventional methods, here output voltage of the converter is given to the MPPT controller. The change in voltage with respect to change in duty ratio for each cycle determines the duty ratio for the switch. The system was simulated using MATLAB/Simulink and the results were obtained as expected.

articleTitle: IGBT Based Bridge Type Fault Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: feature extraction; learning (artificial intelligence); diseases; image segmentation; medical image processing; support vector machines; image classification; neural nets; brain; control system synthesis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supervised Learning Techniques for Cost Effective Disease Prediction Using Non-Clinical Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The rising costs of healthcare services have forced many to undergo annual screening procedures to reduce the incidence of chronic diseases. Diabetes being chronic in nature is always screened in the so called “wellness programs”. Data mining models involving clinical parameters obtained from screening procedures have been successfully implemented for disease prediction. This study sheds light on the use of some novel non-clinical parameters to predict diabetes. This move can be successfully implemented to reduce the screening cost of patients for diseases. The proposed model gives the best results with Random Forest classifier for diabetic prediction.

articleTitle: Second-Order Cyclostationarity for Blind Symbol Rate Estimation of APSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Blind signal identification is the backbone of cognitive radio. Cognitive technologies are now being introduced in the satellite communication. Symbol rate estimation is a critical step in the blind signal identification. In this work, we use the second-order cyclostationarity for estimating the symbol rate of the APSK signals used in satellite communication standard DVB-S2. The performance of the estimator is investigated under different scenarios described in the standard.

articleTitle: Spam Detection Framework for Online Reviews Using Hadoop’ s Computational Capability
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Nowadays, online reviews have become one of the vital elements for customers to do online shopping. Organizations and individuals use this information to buy the right products and make business decisions. This has influenced the spammers or unethical business people to create false reviews and promote their products to out-beat competitions. Sophisticated systems are developed by spammers to create bulk of spam reviews in any websites within hours. To tackle this problem, studies have been conducted to formulate effective ways to detect the spam reviews. Various spam detection methods have been introduced in which most of them extracts meaningful features from the text or used machine learning techniques. These approaches gave little importance on extracted feature type and processing rate. NetSpam[1] defines a framework which can classify the review dataset based on spam features and maps them to a spam detection procedure which performs better than previous works in predictive accuracy. In this work, a method is proposed that can improve the processing rate by applying a distributed approach on review dataset using MapReduce feature. Parallel programming concept using MapReduce is used for processing big data in Hadoop. The solution involves parallelising the algorithm defined in NetSpam and it defines a spam detection procedure with better predictive accuracy and processing rate.

articleTitle: Indirect Space Vector Modulation Based Three Phase Matrix Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Three phase rectifier and Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) are replaced by Matrix Converters (MC) in AC-DC-AC conversion in recent advancements. MC is an AC- AC converter having sinusoidal output voltage and current. This drive is superior to a conventional VSI. Usually a 3X3 matrix converter is used because of our load and supply is three phase. The main objective of the paper is to generate an output voltage having a different voltage level as compared to input voltage level with sinusoidal shape. It is done by using indirect space vector modulation technique in matrix converter. By this approach, we can reduce the complexity of Space vector modulated multilevel inverters. In the Indirect Space Vector Modulation (ISVM) technique, simultaneous O/P voltage and I/P current can be obtained by employing the inverter stage Space Vector Modulation (SVM) with rectifier stage SVM.

articleTitle: Dependency Parser for Malayalam: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: A Dependency parser is important for applications like sentence structure identification, machine translation, clause boundary identification, question answering system etc. No work has been done so far in the field of dependency parser for Malayalam using machine learning approaches. Like any other Indian languages, Malayalam is a morphologically rich- less word order language (MoR-LWO). This property has the negative effect on the correctness of ordinary parsing. The proposed system is a dependency parser model for Malayalam using machine learning. Malt Parser with LIBSVM algorithm is used for modeling the proposed system.

articleTitle: I-Vectors for Forensic Automatic Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Forensic Automatic Speaker Recognition (FASR) will determine whether a voice recording (trace) in query belongs to a particular individual (suspected speaker). The aftereffect of voice disguise, Voice over IP (VoIP), and channel mismatches are important issues to be addressed in FASR. I-vectors have recently gained prominence in text-independent speaker verification, which can cope well with the above mentioned variability in speech. For this work, speech from 18 speakers through close speaking microphone, masked microphone, VoIP and telephone channel is collected to create a database. Utilizing this database, a speaker recognition framework using I-vectors is implemented and evaluated.

articleTitle: Robust Control of a Dimensionless Dual Axis MEMS Vibratory Gyroscope- A Sliding Mode Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper proposes a control using sliding mode technique for the tracking control of Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) vibratory gyroscope. This control strategy relies on the force re-balance control methodology. The control based on LQ minimisation methodology is robust to parameter variations and ensures convergence of position tracking in the presence of fabrication imperfections, noise etc. The stability is analyzed and the tracking ability is demonstrated in the simulation study. The controller design is done for the non dimensional model of the gyroscope which makes it possible to adapt for any gyroscope design.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Low Frequency Oscillations in Two Area System Using STATCOM with PODC
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Inter-area oscillations occurs mainly due to interactions between synchronous generators. These oscillations cause restraining of power transmission in transmission line. To investigate the performance of practical power system allied with wind farms, a two-area power system with an integrated Dynamic Slip Induction Generator (DSIG)-based onshore and Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG)-based offshore Wind Farm is studied. This paper investigates the improvement of power oscillation damping of a two area system with integrated wind farms. The main contribution of this paper is to design a Power Oscillation Damping Controller (PODC) connected to AC voltage controller of STATCOM to damp out oscillations in the two-area study system. Identifying the location of STATCOM is also considered in this paper. STATOM is located at the weakest bus which is identified by plotting P-V curves. This approach also helps in improving the loadability of the system. The studies made in this paper are performed using power system analysis toolbox (PSAT), which is a powerful toolbox in MATLAB for power system analysis and MATLAB/SIMULINK model for time domain simulations.

articleTitle: Indoor Propagation of IRNSS Signals: Preliminary Results
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: With latest technologies most of the smart devices are expected to work in all types of environments including indoor scenarios. But, conventional Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receivers when used in indoor environments face difficulty in dealing with the propagating signals, hence channel modeling of signals in indoor is necessary. In this paper, experiments are carried out using IRNSS S1 and L5 signals at three indoor locations to compare their performance with the corresponding outdoor locations only differed by altitude. The experimental environment and effect of signal obstructions are explained using C/No and system specifications. The results would be useful in designing indoor applications of IRNSS.

articleTitle: Design Development and Performance Analysis of Homopolar Inductor Pulsed Alternator
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: High frequency and high voltage supply is needed for many applications such as laser application, electromagnetic launch and capacitor charging. Pulsed power supply has advantage of better energy storage density, sufficient power density and high reliability. Pulsed power supply is useful in applications like electromagnetic launch. In this paper the magnetic and performance analysis of Homopolar Inductor Alternator is described. The integrated machine can generate pulsed power supply of high magnitude and frequency. Machine consists of 3 sections of rotor. Two sections of equal number of pole work as alternator and the other section work as motor. All the three sections are integrated together as a single rotor structure. The three sections have different axial length and different pole pairs. Motor works at a lower frequency compared to alternator. A low frequency low voltage supply is used to drive high frequency and high voltage supply by integrating them together. Machine works at a rated speed of 18000rpm. Machine is designed and developed in ANSYS Maxwell and magnetic analysis is done and output voltage waveform is obtained.

articleTitle: Eigen Analysis Based Document Summarization
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: This paper presents an effective method of summarizing a text document using the Eigen analysis of the sentence semantic similarity matrix, assuming the graph-based document model. The semantic similarity between sentences is identified using the similarity information extracted from Wordnet. Eigen analysis reveals the candidate sentences to be chosen for the extractive summary. The sentences that make up the document summary are extracted by prioritizing the Eigen values of the semantic similarity matrix of each paragraph. The proposed method was evaluated over sets of research papers, short stories, news articles, etc., The ROUGE score obtained shows that the proposed system generates summaries of acceptable quality.

articleTitle: Effect of White Noise on the Structural Properties of Networks Arose from Time Series
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Time series analysis has a wide range of applications in many research fields and tools using linear methods to the artificial neural network has been employed to model the same. In the recent past, increased attention has been gained by network theory to study the time series arise from various systems. There are different methods available to construct the network from time series. Even though many naturally occurring time series are distorted by noise, its effects on the associated networks are not been investigated yet. In this work, we analyse the effect of time series measurement noise on the parameters of the associated network. The research demonstrates that upto a certain level of noise networks are stable and it has no effect on the structural properties. As the noise level is increased the structure started deteriorating towards a completely disconnected network.

articleTitle: A Combined Reward-Penalty Loss Function Based Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a novel combined reward cum penalty loss function to handle the classification problem. The proposed Reward cum Penalty loss function based Support Vector Machine (RP-SVM) penalizes those data points which do not lie on the desired location and assigns reward for those data points which lie on the desired location. Unlike C-SVM, the RP-SVM can utilize the full information contained in the training set which makes it to own better generalization ability.

articleTitle: Secure Separable Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted JPEG Bitstreams
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: There are various methods to exchange secret data from source to destination. Data stowing away be the strategy to insert data into secured media like picture. At the point when a remote server gets the encoded bit stream, the information hider go through the bit stream and embeds extra messages in it utilizing an inserting key by safeguarding the bit stream estimate as original. On the beneficiary side, the extra messages can likewise be removed from the received bit stream if the inserting key is accessible. A beneficiary with just the encryption key can see an estimated picture by an immediate decryption. On the of chance that both the encryption and inserting keys are accessible, the beneficiary can losslessly recuperate the original bit stream followed by the decoding of the marked encoded JPEG bit stream. By these techniques the mystery information security could be upgraded and besides the genuine picture and in addition the concealed information could be almost recovered with out any loss. RC4 is a standout among the most generally used stream cipher for picture encryption due to its straightforwardness, speed and efficiency. The flaws in RC4 are putting forth an open challenge for designers, prompts factual shortcoming in generated key stream for it could be retrieved through a simple brute force attack. Even though RC4 is simple, it took more time for execution. To gain a reduction in the execution time and to enhance security, substituting RC4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[6]</sup> with ChaCha Algorithm with 8, 12 and 20 rounds. Key sharing concept could be enforced through multiple level of encryption asymmetrically by embedding the encoded encryption and inserting key in the reserved application header segments of the image. Moreover the work shall be conducted to update the comparison of the stated algorithms over a group of images and find out the execution in an empirical way.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Algorithm for Tolerating Security Threats in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a promising network with wireless infrastructure to provide secure service to the users anywhere and anytime. In this type of wireless infrastructure, reliability is a major issue because it affects the multicasting due to link or node failure, opportunistic packet loss, and lowest degree of latency. These three deficiencies may affect the reliable multicast in WSN. The comprehensive solutions of Hybrid Position-based Adaptive Low Packet Loss Routing (H-PAL-PLR) protocol of WSNs are against opportunistic packet loss. In addition to this, Hybrid Optimized Localization with Long-Lifetime and Low-Latency Data Aggregation Scheduling algorithm (HOL-5-DAS) for low latency reliable multicast routing in wireless transmission. H-PAL-PLR Routing protocol consists of combination of position-based protocols and adaptive low packet loss routing protocol is used to protect the wireless sensor networks from the packet loss. The proposed model of MRM, H-PAL-PLR, and HOL-5-DAS has been proved to be efficient in case of link or node failure, packet loss and latency respectively. Likewise the proposed models show better performance in terms of packet delivery ratio, network life time, throughput, latency ratio and packet loss ratio parameters and those are experimentally proved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Performance and Reliability of Network File System
publicationTitle: 2018 International CET Conference on Control, Communication, and Computing (IC4)
abstract: Network File System is a widely used distributed file system that allows the user to access and manipulate storage on remote computers, as if they were a part of the local machine. Network File System is notoriously slow in its default configuration and if more clients connects to the NFS environment, it merely accentuates the delay. When configured to deliver faster speeds, the system suffers from higher risk of data corruption and loss. This study proposes a number of modifications to the Network File System, enabling it to provide elevated system performance, while containing the risk of data loss and corruption.
